Normalize and Validate a Browser Locale String

Source: R/utils_translation.R
detect_browser_language.Rd

Extracts the two-letter ISO 639-1 language prefix from a raw locale header or navigator.language value (e.g., "de-DE" -> "de") and validates it against supported.

Usage

detect_browser_language(
  raw_lang = NULL,
  supported = get_supported_languages(),
  fallback = "en"
)

Arguments

raw_lang

Character scalar from navigator.language or HTTP_ACCEPT_LANGUAGE.

supported

Character vector of allowed language codes. Defaults to get_supported_languages().

fallback

Character scalar fallback language code returned if raw_lang is unsupported or empty. Defaults to "en".

Value

A validated two-letter character language code (e.g., "de" or "en").

Examples

detect_browser_language("de-DE")
#> [1] "de"
detect_browser_language("fr-FR", fallback = "en")
#> [1] "en"
